exercises.why: **узнава́ть** — to know, to recognize. Wiktionary: узна́ть + -ва́ть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: быва́ть — (imperfective only) to be; дава́ть — to give; узнава́ть — to know, to recognize; забыва́ть — to forget.
**встава́ть** — to stand up, to get up, to rise. Wiktionary: встать + -ва́ть.
**успева́ть** — to have time, to find time, to manage, to succeed. Wiktionary: успе́ть + -ва́ть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to stand up, to get up, to rise
to have time, to find time, to manage, to succeed
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: встава́ть — to stand up, to get up, to rise; убива́ть — to kill; открыва́ть — to open; успева́ть — to have time, to find time, to manage, to succeed.
**перестава́ть** — to stop, to cease, to quit. Wiktionary: переста́ть + -ва́ть.
